image_generation.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square PBR base color texture for a Unity microscopic exploration game. Flat orthographic close-up of healthy human dorsal tongue mucosa, realistic densely packed very fine filiform papillae with sparse slightly larger pink fungiform papillae. Warm muted rose coral pink living tissue, subtle natural color variation, delicate detail. Uniform scale over entire square, seamlessly tileable on all four edges. Diffuse cross-polarized even lighting, no baked shadows or highlights, no perspective, no distinct central feature or groove, no large lumps, no teeth, no mouth silhouette, no objects, no text. The surface should appear soft and delicate, not gravel, stone, reptile scales or rough meat. 1024 square texture.
